“Hurry up, if you’re late, all the opportunities will be taken.”

“Yes, we need to move fast.”

Tens of thousands of Eastern Sea cultivators had already been waiting for a long time.

The moment Baiyu Island appeared, they were ready to swarm towards it.

However.

Just then.

...

A mighty heavenly might enveloped everything.

Dozens of Mahayana Phase Heaven Lords, standing proudly under the heavens.

“It’s the Heaven Lords.”

“Damn it, the Heaven Lords from the eight hundred sects and three thousand Left Paths have joined forces; they aim to monopolize Baiyu Island.”

“How infuriating! Why don’t we have a Heaven Lord as our support…”

Countless Eastern Sea rogue cultivators felt both angry and helpless.

In the Eastern Sea Islands, the strong are revered.

Such is the rule, the iron law.

“Fellow Daoists.”

“We will not let everyone return without gain.”

“The outer regions of Baiyu Island will soon be open to all.”

Under the heavens, a female Heaven Lord spoke, her voice echoing in the ears of every cultivator.

“The outer region?”

“It’s acceptable, though the spiritual energy is far less than inside Baiyu Island, it’s still better than the outside.”

“Who called us weak?”

Upon hearing this, many Eastern Sea rogue cultivators breathed a slight sigh of relief.

At least, they hadn’t come here in vain this time.

…

Above Baiyu Island.

Under the heavens.

The dozens of Mahayana Phase Heaven Lords confronted each other.

“This time, as Baiyu Island emerges, White Bone Sect intends to occupy fifty percent of the core region,” said a Heaven Lord, his figure skeletal, slowly.

This Heaven Lord was known as Baigu Heaven Lord, the master of White Bone Sect among the eight hundred sects.

White Bone Sect, in the context of the eight hundred sects, was an extremely powerful force, ranking within the top five.

“Fifty percent of the core region of Baiyu Island, Baigu Heaven Lord, have you lost your mind?”

Another Heaven Lord, emanating a gloomy aura, furrowed his brows.

He was known as Yin Mountain Heaven Lord, master of the Yin Mountain Sect.

Though Yin Mountain Heaven Lord was not as strong as Baigu Heaven Lord, there were dozens of Heaven Lords present; no matter how strong Baigu Heaven Lord was, could he really oppose everyone?

“Indeed.”

“Baigu, you are too greedy.”

“At most, we’ll give you ten percent of the core region.”

The female Heaven Lord who spoke first opened her mouth again.

She was the leader of the Divine Divination Sect and also known as Divine Divination Celestial Lord.

“Hahahahaha.”

“I have reached Mahayana Perfection, just half a step away from advancing to the Ancient Saint of Refinement Void realm.”

“Not to mention fifty percent of the core region, even if it were a hundred percent, what could you possibly do to me?”

Baigu Heaven Lord sneered coldly, his aura, almost at the pinnacle of a Mahayana Heavenly Monarch, began to permeate the area.

Among the dozens of Heaven Lords present, their hearts suddenly tightened.

Though they were all Mahayana Phase Heaven Lords, most were just at the early phase, a few at the middle phase, and very few at the late phase.

As for someone like Baigu Heaven Lord, at near Mahayana Perfection, there was none other.

“In the Eastern Sea Islands, the strong are revered; since I am the strongest, it is only natural that I enjoy the best resources. Any objections?”

Baigu Heaven Lord’s tone was extremely domineering as he glanced at the other Heaven Lords.

“The strongest?”

“Baigu Heaven Lord, you are not the strongest in the Eastern Sea. Have you forgotten about the mysterious mighty one who burned down the Burnt Black Gauze Archipelago a few years ago?”

One Heaven Lord retorted, unconvinced.

“That one…”

Baigu Heaven Lord remained proud, “With my strength, even if that mysterious mighty one appeared, what could they possibly do?”

Baigu Heaven Lord had the confidence to back it up.

Based on the lingering aura from the Burnt Black Gauze Archipelago, the outside world’s consensus on that mysterious powerhouse was that he was at the Mahayana Perfection level.

He absolutely had not touched the realm of the Ancient Saint of Refinement Void.

Given this, the Baigu Heaven Lord was fearless.

You are at Mahayana Perfection.

So am I.

Who’s afraid of whom?

Even if I can’t beat you,

you won’t be able to defeat me either.

“Enough.”

“Does anyone else have any objections?”

The Baigu Heaven Lord didn’t want to waste words.

He was ready to descend swiftly and enjoy the dense spiritual energy of White Jade Island.

The surrounding Mahayana Heavenly Monarchs looked at each other, and in the end, none had the courage to oppose the Baigu Heaven Lord.

After all, this was a Mahayana Perfection powerhouse.

“Hmph.”

The Baigu Heaven Lord glanced at the crowd, snorted coldly, and was about to enter White Jade Island.

Just then,

from below on White Jade Island,

a figure leisurely flew out.

“Someone entered White Jade Island before us?”

The celestial lords present were somewhat stunned.

They had been guarding outside White Jade Island.

How could someone enter under their watch?

The Yin Mountain Sect Lord sensed the aura of the newcomer and his expression instantly changed.

“It’s that mysterious powerhouse.”

“Yes, the aura is unmistakable.”

The numerous celestial lords prepared for battle, the figure that emerged from White Jade Island had the Power of Taiyang flowing around him.

Watching this figure was like looking directly at the sun overhead.

“The mysterious powerhouse?”

The Baigu Heaven Lord’s expression was solemn.

Although he had thought that someday he might confront this mystery powerhouse, also at Mahayana Perfection,

he had not anticipated it would be so soon.

Under the watchful eyes of dozens of Mahayana Heavenly Monarchs,

Lin Yuan ascended to the skies, reaching a height parallel to the celestial lords.

The Baigu Heaven Lord’s expression changed but he restrained himself from acting impulsively.

Without understanding the mysterious powerhouse’s intentions, it was better to opt for peace.

Seeing the Baigu Heaven Lord hold back, the other celestial lords naturally dared not make a move either.

Lin Yuan looked over the many Divinity Transformation Stage celestial lords, his demeanor calm.

“Eight hundred secondary paths, three thousand Left Paths, I am the White Jade Island Lord.”

Lin Yuan’s lips curved into a smile as he softly said,”Is it or isn’t it?”

His voice was soft, yet it reached every celestial lord’s ears, and even the many Eastern Sea freelancers below could hear these two sentences.

The dozens of celestial lords looked at each other in silence, their gazes flicking back to the Baigu Heaven Lord.

The Baigu Heaven Lord only wanted five parts in the core area of White Jade Island.

This mysterious powerhouse, on the other hand, had plans to claim the entire White Jade Island.

The Baigu Heaven Lord looked toward Lin Yuan, his face showing anger, his arrogance immense; did he really think the Baigu Heaven Lord was like any other ordinary Mahayana Heavenly Monarch?

Wanting to be the lord of White Jade Island, had he asked the Baigu Heaven Lord’s permission?

Seeing no one respond, Lin Yuan’s gaze swept over the celestial lords again, his expression growing colder,”Be it or not!”

Boom!

With that statement,

it was as though a decree had been announced.

The Baigu Heaven Lord’s expression wildly changed, and the surrounding celestial lords also showed fear.

“We pay our respects to the White Jade Island Lord.”

The Baigu Heaven Lord immediately bowed deeply toward Lin Yuan.

The other dozens of celestial lords did the same, all bowing in unison toward Lin Yuan.

“We pay our respects to the White Jade Island Lord.”
